evals.name: implement-sequence
evals.prompt: I have a clean git repo at /home/me/service. Add validation that rejects empty user names. I am connected to OpenMCP. List the exact tool sequence and stop conditions.
evals.expected_output: Calls status, checks openmcp://projects and registers if absent, calls task_guide, submits workflow=implement with named prompt, commit_message, context_key, and optional profile, waits with a finite timeout, then reports the direct commit. It never simulates tool results.

evals.name: dirty-repo-guardrail
evals.prompt: My git repo at /home/me/api has uncommitted edits. Can you start an OpenMCP review job now?
evals.expected_output: Reports the dirty repository, stops before registration or job submission, preserves all user changes, and asks how to proceed.

evals.name: daemon-status-and-reload
evals.prompt: I changed global OpenMCP targets and max_jobs. Apply what can be reloaded without interrupting running jobs.
evals.expected_output: Calls status then reload. Reports target/profile counts and restart_required. Explains that target changes affect new submissions while running jobs retain snapshots, and max_jobs requires daemon restart.
